name: Mẫu Làm Video Nông Nghiệp Cực Nhanh
description: Quảng cáo sản phẩm 7 cảnh kiểu TikTok/Reels: hook vấn đề → sản phẩm xuất hiện → trước/sau → hero shot → ưu đãi + CTA. Thoại tiếng Việt giọng miền Nam

variables.label: Mô tả sản phẩm (bao bì, dung tích, màu sắc, đặc điểm nhận dạng)
variables.default: Chai thuốc trừ bệnh cho lúa, nhãn in rõ tên Aben 10S

variables.label: Lợi ích chính / vấn đề sản phẩm giải quyết
variables.default: Đặc trị nấm bệnh đạo ôn, đốm nâu trên lúa, giúp hạt chắc và vàng sáng

variables.label: Khách hàng mục tiêu
variables.default: Bà con nông dân trồng lúa

variables.label: Khuyến mãi / giá / ưu đãi
variables.default: Ưu đãi hôm nay – miễn phí giao hàng

variables.label: Lợi ích rút gọn 5–8 chữ (chữ trên màn hình)
variables.default: Sạch nấm bệnh, hạt chắc vàng óng

variables.label: Câu thoại mở đầu — hook vấn đề
variables.default: Trời ơi, lúa nhà tui bị đạo ôn hết trơn rồi!

variables.label: Câu thoại nói về lợi ích
variables.default: Xịt một lần là nấm bệnh sạch trơn, lúa xanh lại liền!

variables.label: Cam kết thương hiệu (câu chốt)
variables.default: lúa khỏe, hạt chắc, được mùa

attachments.label: Ảnh sản phẩm
attachments.hint: Ảnh chai/gói rõ nhãn — giữ đúng bao bì
attachments.prompt: the product must look exactly like this (same packaging, shape, label design and colors) in every scene

attachments.label: Ảnh nhân vật & phong cách
attachments.hint: Nhân vật, bối cảnh, phong cách hình ảnh
attachments.prompt: use these characters, the rice field scenery and this visual style for the video

attachments.label: Video tham khảo (nhịp, phong cách)
attachments.hint: Ảnh hoặc video mẫu — video sẽ được cắt 1 khung hình
attachments.prompt: use it only as inspiration for pacing, visual energy and advertising style — do not copy it

prompt: Create a highly engaging vertical product advertisement video, 9:16 aspect ratio, optimized for TikTok, Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts.

Use the reference video only as inspiration for its pacing, visual energy, storytelling structure and advertising style. Do NOT copy the original characters, dialogue, branding, exact shots or copyrighted visual elements.

Fast-paced commercial storytelling, visually satisfying, cinematic but realistic, strong hook in the first 2 seconds, exaggerated product demonstration, energetic transitions, clear visual storytelling even when watched without sound.
Immediately show a common problem that the target customer experiences.
Make the situation visually dramatic, surprising or slightly exaggerated so viewers stop scrolling.
Use a fast camera push-in and expressive reaction from the main character.
Show the problem becoming more obvious.
The character looks frustrated and searches for a solution.
The product appears clean, premium and visually dominant in the frame.
Use a cinematic hero shot, slow rotation, subtle light sweep and shallow depth of field.
Clearly show the product packaging and brand name.
Show the product being used naturally.
Focus on the most important product feature:
Use close-up shots, macro product details and visually satisfying transformation shots.
Show a clear BEFORE → PRODUCT USED → AFTER sequence.
Show the customer receiving an obvious positive result.
Expression changes from frustration to satisfaction and confidence.
The improvement must be immediately understandable without explanation.
Show the product in a beautiful advertising composition.
Clean background related to the product category.
Add supporting elements around the product that reinforce its benefits.
Finish with a strong product shot and clear promotional message.
Professional studio lighting mixed with natural environmental lighting.
Keep the product design identical throughout all scenes.
Mix of wide shot, medium shot, close-up and macro shot.
Smooth stabilized camera movement when the product appears.
Slow cinematic orbit for the final product hero shot.
Strong visual transitions between problem and solution.
Synchronize major visual changes with sound effects.
Impact sound during the opening hook.
Keep music slightly lower when dialogue is spoken.
Use natural Southern Vietnamese conversational speech.
The advertisement should feel entertaining first and promotional second.
Avoid making the video look like a traditional television commercial.
Make it feel native to TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts, with a strong first-second hook and a satisfying product reveal.
